nom: Peter Thomas Roth Anti-Aging Cleansing Gel

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily/combination skin report the cleanser works well used a few times a week and gives a glowing effect, though one oily/combo reviewer reports breakouts along the jawline after about two weeks of use.
segments.dry: Reviewers who state they have dry skin generally report it does not strip or dry their skin when paired with moisturizer, but several other reviewers not identifying as chronically dry describe new dryness, tightness or flaking from this product.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report soft, smooth, less textured skin over time and no drying, using it once a day or a few times a week.
segments.sensitive: Reports from self-identified sensitive skin are split: some say it is gentle, non-irritating and leaves time before needing moisturizer, while others report hives, rashes, breakouts or peeling and warn sensitive skin to avoid it, consistent with the product's own sensitive-skin warning.
segments.normal: The few reviewers describing normal/regular skin report negative reactions, including burning, irritation, or a drying effect on the neck and face.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 30s to 60s report brighter, smoother, firmer-looking skin and visible reduction in fine lines with regular use, though one mature-skin reviewer reports a rash and breakouts and discontinued use.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers using it for anti-aging report brighter, firmer, smoother-looking skin and reduced fine lines, often citing use in their 30s-60s; one reviewer used it a week and could not yet judge anti-aging results.
concerns.dehydration: Many say it cleans without stripping or drying skin when paired with a moisturizer, but a substantial number describe significant dryness, tightness, or flaking, with some stopping use for this reason.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness or calmed rosacea with regular use, but others describe new redness, hives or a burning rash appearing on the neck or cheeks.
concerns.barrier: Some reviewers note the product can compromise the skin barrier if used without a strong moisturizer, describing peeling or sunburn-like sensations, while others report no barrier issues when moisturizer is used consistently.
concerns.spots: Reviewers using it for acne scars report fading of scars over time, including from psoriasis, alongside reports of brighter, more even skin.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report clearer skin and resolved cystic or jawline acne within days to weeks; however, at least two reviewers report new breakouts, bumps, or white pimples after starting the product.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report the product cleans oil and makeup without leaving residue or excess oil, using it a few times weekly rather than daily.

aspects.libelle: Formula seems changed or watered down
Small amount needed, bottle lasts long

extraits.titre: NOT FOR SENSITIVE SKIN AT ALL!
extraits.texte: I bought this cleanser for my mature skin. I like the brand however, this particular cleanser, it's overpriced and it irritated my skin so much I broke out in a rash, all over my face. I thought maybe I'll give it a few more days and it will go away. NOPE! I kept getting more white pimples. It was so bad I was embarrassed to go to work. I ended up throwing the bottle away. 😞

I got this in one of those sets on sale with 4 full sized products, so I figured I'd give it a try. It's a really nice size and it's true: you don't need a lot of it. I do enjoy the grapefruit smell that many others have been commenting about. HOWEVER, I began to get little bumps along my lower cheeks/jawline and I wondered what'd caused this? The reaction didn't appear initially, but this is the only thing I've changed in my routine and the bumps became apparent almost 2 weeks into using this product, so my conclusion is my breakouts were caused by this face wash. The thing is, I don't have very sensitive skin and I'm not easily prone to break outs, so the way my skin reacted has really made my confidence level go way down and I'm really embarrassed by the acne it caused... I really wanted to love it, and I'm sure it works great for other people, but be warned! For reference, I have oily/ combo, medium skin.

I've been using this daily for the last year and a half. It made a night and day difference in the brightness and evenness of my skin almost immediately. An unrelenting case of rosacea also stopped. It leaves my face SO soft. It has faded a couple of scars from psoriasis. My son had horrible acne. This has helped stop it In its tracks and helped to fade his scars. Looks like it's going to get rid of them completely. Yes it is very drying if you do not use a moisturizer as anything else that has salicylic or glycolic acid does. This also has a lot of citric acids (vitamin c) that also can be irritant to sensitive skin. Mine is fairly sensitive but I've had no issues. I use Clinique Moisture Surge gel faithfully every single day following my shower and have zero drying issues. My son does as well and his skin is super prone to drying but has no issues as long as he uses the moisture surge with it. It leaves my skin so soft, I have started adding a small drop to my body wash when I shower and the rest of my body is getting the same benefits my face has. Can't rave about this enough. Use a good moisturizer with it and you'll be fine. Doesn't need to be a heavy one, just very hydrating. Avoid doubling up on anything else that has citric/ascorbic acid/vitamin c, salicylic acid (most acne washes), glycolic acid or benzoyl peroxide in it as it will be too much and will cause inflammation. Just pay attention to what is in your products. If you use retinol products, try to use them sep

extraits.titre: The first step to glowing skin
extraits.texte: I use this 3-4 times a week without issue and I have oily skin. This also plays well with the brand's Retinol Fusion PM. I get so many compliments on my glowing skin. Basically, this stuff works but you have to know a bit about proper skincare. Like, DO NOT use chemical exfoliants, like this cleanser, daily! Give your skin a break. Also, always follow up with a hydrating moisturizer (try PTR's Water Drench or Neutrogena's Hydroboost or Rovectin's Lotus Water Cream. I do not recommend Tatcha). And do not forget to wear sunscreen. The AHAs and BHAs in this sensitize your skin and make it easier for the sun to damage it.

I love this! I am in my late 30's and keeping my skin looking young has turned into an obsession (lol). I have VERY sensitive skin, have a very oily T zone, and very dry patches in other areas. I cannot use this every day or it will dry my skin out to much. So I use this 2-3 times a week and it helps keep my skin clear and glowing without being to abrasive.

This cleanser makes my skin feel so clean and refreshed. It easily removes the makeup residue and oils after using a makeup remover. This has a pleasant smell and isn't very drying. I have combination skin and aging skin. I use this once a day.

I NEVER leave reviews and have normal skin. Not sensitive at all. One day I noticed my neck was SO red. Then the next day the same thing. I couldn't figure out why until I realized it was from this cleanser completely DRYING out my skin. Not only on my neck but my face started drying out so bad and was flaking! I have never had this problem with any skincare product or face wash. Unbelievably horrible!
